data.long_meaning: The name Gruver is derived from the Old English word 'grif' meaning 'strong' and 'weard' meaning 'power' or 'ruler'. This name was commonly given to individuals who held positions of authority or power, and was used to instill a sense of strength and courage in those who bore it. The name Gruver carries the meaning “Strong, power, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Gruver usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, power, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
